svg.text: The PHY presents ONE DFI interface; all ports live on it. Braces group by interface type / reference clock domain: command (cmd-clk), write & read data (data-clk), status/update and error/low-power (ctrl-clk). Phase signals (_pN) are x GEAR copies; only _p0 drawn.
